tools.name: bigtime_list_staff
tools.description: List staff members (id = staff sid, name, email). Good first call. BigTime API: GET /staff.

tools.name: bigtime_get_staff
tools.description: Get one staff member by staff sid. BigTime API: GET /staff/detail/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_projects
tools.description: List projects (id, name, client, status). BigTime API: GET /project.

tools.name: bigtime_get_project
tools.description: Get one project by sid, with budget, dates and billing setup. BigTime API: GET /project/detail/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_get_project_team
tools.description: List the staff assigned to a project. BigTime API: GET /project/team/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (id, name, client id). BigTime API: GET /client.

tools.name: bigtime_get_client
tools.description: Get one client by sid. BigTime API: GET /client/detail/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_project_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks of one project. BigTime API: GET /task/listByProject/{ProjectSid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_staff_tasks
tools.description: List the tasks assigned to one staff member. BigTime API: GET /task/ListByStaffer/{StaffSid}.

tools.name: bigtime_get_task
tools.description: Get one task by sid. BigTime API: GET /task/detail/{TaskSid}.

tools.name: bigtime_get_timesheet
tools.description: List the time entries of one staff member in a date range. BigTime API: GET /time/Sheet/{staffsid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_project_time
tools.description: List the time entries logged on one project in a date range. BigTime API: GET /time/ByProject/{Id}.

tools.name: bigtime_get_time_entry
tools.description: Get one time entry by sid. BigTime API: GET /time/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_get_daily_totals
tools.description: Get the hours per day for one staff member in a date range. BigTime API: GET /time/TotalByDay/{staffsid}.

tools.name: bigtime_get_expense
tools.description: Get one expense entry by sid. BigTime API: GET /expense/detail/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_expense_reports
tools.description: List expense reports. BigTime API: GET /expense/reports.

tools.name: bigtime_list_invoices
tools.description: List issued invoices in a date range. BigTime API: GET /invoice/history.

tools.name: bigtime_list_draft_invoices
tools.description: List draft invoices, optionally in a date range. BigTime API: GET /invoice/drafts.

tools.name: bigtime_get_invoice
tools.description: Get one invoice by sid. BigTime API: GET /invoice/detail/{sid}.

tools.name: bigtime_list_client_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of one client in a date range. BigTime API: GET /invoice/GetInvoicesByClientId.

tools.name: bigtime_list_payments
tools.description: List payments received in a date range. BigTime API: GET /payment/history.

tools.name: bigtime_get_report_definition
tools.description: Get the definition (fields and filters) of a saved report. BigTime API: GET /report/detail/{id}.

tools.name: bigtime_run_report
tools.description: Run a saved BigTime report and return its rows. Pass the report filters as a JSON object, for example {"DT_BEGIN":"2026-01-01","DT_END":"2026-01-31"}. Read only. BigTime API: POST /report/data/{id}.

tools.name: bigtime_create_time_entry
tools.description: WRITE: log time for a staff member on a project. Creates a new time entry in BigTime (it does not replace one). Set mark_submitted to submit it for approval at once. BigTime API: POST /time.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: bigtime_list_staff, bigtime_run_report · Public sink: bigtime_list_staff, bigtime_run_report, bigtime_create_time_entry · Destructive: bigtime_run_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: bigtime_list_staff, bigtime_run_report · Public sink: bigtime_list_staff, bigtime_run_report, bigtime_create_time_entry · Destructive: bigtime_run_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
